result.title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 EEGProbe 基准，用 620 道题、13 个子任务与三类能力（信号分类、跨模态对齐、神经生理推理）检验通用 VLM 能否在极少预处理下直接从通道级 EEG 中提取并推理信号，并在统一零样本协议下评测 11 个模型，最强模型总分仅 41.63%，跨模态对齐是主要瓶颈，另分析 EEG 时频空结构对成败的影响及推理期神经生理引导的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: EEG 属远离视觉推理的模态，但其「signal-necessity testing」加专家核验的题目构造，以及跨模态对齐瓶颈的失败诊断，可能可供核查 LVR 中模型是否真正依赖输入证据（视觉旁路）与证据筛选的评价设计。
